accountabilities: Own technical security architecture facts and deployment evidence.
Confirm remediation state for technical findings.
Confirm product behavior, tenancy features and roadmap commitments.
Avoid representing planned capability as current capability.
Review contractual, privacy and regulatory commitments.
Approve language that creates legal or contractual obligations.
Own control mappings, audit evidence and approved policy/control statements.
Track assurance scope, evidence freshness and exceptions.
Translate approved facts into customer-facing security answers.
Route unsupported or ambiguous questions to the accountable function.

non_claims: The reference pack is not a customer-specific attestation.
A documented control is not evidence of operating effectiveness.
Certification or independent-assessment claims require external assurance evidence.
